findings.note: Senate vote on House Bill 958, Election Law Changes. The ratified bill (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) adds G.S. 163-83, which has county boards process a voter registration application only if it affirmatively says the applicant is a US citizen, with a 30-day notice and a statement under penalty of perjury if the question is left blank. It also directs the State Board of Elections to set up a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The roll call lists Chaudhuri among the noes. The bill was later vetoed on 2026-08-17 per the bill page https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958.

findings.passage: I served as the primary sponsor of the Safer Schools, Healthier Kids Act, a bill that authorizes extreme risk protection orders to temporarily restrict firearms if a person poses danger of physical harm to themselves or others. This bill also requires a permit to purchase assault-style firearms and long guns, raises the age of sale of these firearms, and bans instruments such as bump stocks and trigger cranks.
